SysML:requirement.text: The quadcopter shall have a battery.
The quadcopter shall have a pressure sensor.
The quadcopter shall have four motors.
The quadcopter shall have a communications subsystem.
The quadcopter shall have an endurance time of 60 minutes at 50% of thrust.
The quadcopter shall be able to control motor thrust to altitude setpoints.
The quadcopter shall be able to measure its altitude.
The quadcopter shall achieve a direct line-of-sight control distance of 1 mile.
The quadcopter shall achieve a sustained vertical acceleration of 10 ft/s.
